app.name: Harvee: Watch Stress Monitor
app.description: An Apple Watch app that reads heart rate and HRV via HealthKit to deliver stress and recovery insights directly on your wrist.

verdict.one_liner: A health-focused watch app that keeps every heartbeat on your device and collects almost nothing else.
verdict.summary: Harvee is an Apple Watch stress monitor that reads heart rate and heart rate variability through Apple HealthKit. The developer explicitly states that all health data is processed locally on your watch or iPhone, is never transmitted externally, and is never stored on their servers. The app does not collect any personally identifiable information. The only data sharing mentioned is with Apple for refund processing, and only with your explicit consent.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The app handles sensitive health data responsibly by keeping it entirely on-device, does not require an account, and collects no personal information.

red.title: Policy changes may go unnoticed
red.plain_english: The privacy policy only updates a date at the top when it changes. It does not say how you will be notified, so you may not know the rules changed unless you check the website yourself.

green.title: Health data stays on your device
green.plain_english: Your heart rate and HRV data from Apple HealthKit is processed entirely on your Apple Watch or iPhone. It is never sent to the developer's servers or shared with anyone.

green.title: No personal information collected
green.plain_english: The app does not ask for your name, email, address, or phone number. You do not need to create an account.

green.title: All data stays local
green.plain_english: The app stores everything on your device and does not upload it to the cloud. You can manage or remove HealthKit permissions anytime in the Apple Health app.

categories.policy_excerpt: The App does not collect any personally identifiable information such as your name, address, phone number, or email address.

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking

categories.policy_excerpt: We may collect non-personal information such as session duration, interactions, and general usage statistics.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: The app may connect to the internet for app updates or refund processing, but the developer says no data about you is collected.
categories.detail: The app likely requires network connectivity for App Store functions and updates. The privacy policy states no personal data is collected, and all processed information remains local.
categories.policy_excerpt: All information processed by the App remains stored locally on your device.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: The developer says they do not collect device identifiers, except anonymized ones shared with Apple for refund processing only if you consent.
categories.detail: The privacy policy mentions anonymized device identifiers only in the context of refund processing with Apple, and only with explicit user consent. There is no general device fingerprinting or analytics tracking.
categories.policy_excerpt: This may include app usage associated with the purchase, whether the purchase was consumed or not, subscription status, and anonymized device identifiers.

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The app reads your heart rate and HRV from Apple HealthKit to analyze stress, but all processing happens on your device and the data never leaves.
categories.detail: The app accesses heart rate and heart rate variability through Apple HealthKit for stress and recovery analysis. The privacy policy explicitly states all HealthKit data is processed locally on the Apple Watch or iPhone, is not transmitted, stored, or shared externally, and users can manage or revoke HealthKit permissions at any time in the Apple Health app.
categories.policy_excerpt: All HealthKit data is processed locally on your Apple Watch or iPhone. We do not transmit, store, or share this data externally.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Any in-app purchases are handled by Apple. The developer never sees your payment card.
categories.detail: The app offers in-app purchases. The privacy policy states that purchase transaction information is only shared with Apple for refund processing, and the developer does not handle payment data directly.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may collect and share purchase transaction information with Apple when you request a refund for an in-app purchase.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: All your data is stored on your device. You can remove it by uninstalling the app or revoking HealthKit permissions in the Apple Health app.
categories.detail: Because all data is processed and stored locally on the device, deletion is entirely under user control. The privacy policy notes that HealthKit permissions can be managed or revoked at any time in the Apple Health app. Uninstalling the app would also remove any locally stored data.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can manage or revoke HealthKit permissions at any time in the Apple Health app.

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not say how you will be told if the rules change. It only updates a date at the top of the page.
categories.detail: The privacy policy states that changes will be reflected by the 'Last updated' date at the top of the page, but does not mention email alerts, in-app notifications, or requiring users to actively re-agree. This means users might not notice policy changes unless they manually check the website.
categories.policy_excerpt: Any changes will be reflected by the 'Last updated' date at the top of this page.
concerns: No requirement for users to re-consent after changes
